ddl.name: audit_events_actor_consistent
ddl.value: ("actor_kind" = 'user' AND "actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("actor_kind" = 'system' AND "actor_user_id" IS NULL)

ddl.name: outbox_events_dispatch_time_consistent
ddl.value: ("status" = 'pending' AND "dispatched_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'dispatched' AND "dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: appeals_decision_fields_consistent
ddl.value: ("status" = 'pending' AND "decided_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "decided_at" IS NULL AND "decision_reason" IS NULL) OR ("status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected') AND "decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "decision_reason" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: grade_adjustments_appeal_type_consistent
ddl.value: ("adjustment_type" = 'appeal_accepted' AND "appeal_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("adjustment_type" = 'manual_correction' AND "appeal_id" IS NULL)

ddl.name: review_runs_usage_check
ddl.value: ("input_tokens" IS NULL OR "input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("output_tokens" IS NULL OR "output_tokens" >= 0) AND ("cost_usd" IS NULL OR "cost_usd" >= 0)

ddl.name: test_results_metrics_check
ddl.value: ("execution_ms" IS NULL OR "execution_ms" >= 0) AND ("memory_kb" IS NULL OR "memory_kb" >= 0)
